question: 2026年9月一共有多少个订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 含取消订单，全量下单口径

question: 当前在售的商品有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_product WHERE status = 'on_sale'

question: 会员等级为钻石的客户有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_customer WHERE member_level = '钻石'

question: 2026年6月支付成功的笔数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_payment WHERE payment_status = 'success' AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'

question: 已完成订单的总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS amount FROM fact_order WHERE order_status = 'completed'

question: 2026年上半年（1-6月）的订单优惠总额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(discount_amount), 2) AS discount FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

question: 所有商品里价格最高和价格最低分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM dim_product

question: 状态为已完成的退款一共多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_refund WHERE refund_status = 'completed'

question: 2026年9月各一级品类的销售额Top3是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT top.category_name AS cate, ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS sales FROM fact_order_item i JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN dim_category sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN dim_category top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY top.category_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 3
note: 需要从二级品类上卷到一级品类

question: 2026年9月华东区的已支付订单有多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE r.region_name = '华东' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

question: 2026年9月各渠道的订单数和GMV分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.channel_name AS channel, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 2026年9月销售额最高的品牌是哪个？销售额多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS sales FROM fact_order_item i JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026年9月退款金额最高的三个退款原因是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT r.refund_reason AS reason, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS amount FROM fact_refund r JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.requested_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND r.requested_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.refund_reason ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2026年9月钻石会员贡献了多少GMV？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.member_level = '钻石' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

question: 2026年9月里下单量最多的是哪一天？有多少单？
gold_sql: SELECT order_date AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY cnt DESC, order_date ASC LIMIT 1

question: 2026年第三季度（7-9月）的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

question: 2026年9月的订单里，周末下单的占比是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_weekend THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

question: 2026年9月GMV环比8月增长了多少百分比？
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN gmv END) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN gmv END) - 100.0, 2) AS mom_pct FROM m

question: 2026年9月支付成功的订单里，有多少笔是下单日期与支付日期不在同一天的？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_payment p JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE) <> o.order_date

question: 2025年全年的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: 2026年9月的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: GMV=已支付订单（含后来退款），不能只算 completed，否则只有 79 万而非 185 万

question: 2026年9月的净GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM fact_refund r JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND r.completed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'), 0), 2) AS net_gmv
note: 净GMV = 支付口径GMV - 9月完成的退款

question: 2026年9月的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS arpu FROM fact_order WHERE order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
note: 客单价=支付GMV/去重客户数，不是除以订单数

question: 2026年9月的复购率是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cnt >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_order WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY customer_id) t
note: 复购：同一客户9月下单>=2次

question: 按支付日期统计，2026年9月的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.paid_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM fact_payment p JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded') AND p.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND p.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
note: 必须用 paid_at 而非 order_date，跨天支付会产生差异

question: 历史订单里，已下架（off_shelf）商品产生的销售额一共多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.item_amount), 2) AS amount FROM fact_order_item i JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN fact_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE p.status = 'off_shelf' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','shipped','completed','refunded')
note: 下架商品仍在历史订单里，统计销量不应过滤
